Welcome to my first ever horror map! (my 4th total map)

After a long day at work you enter your home, but something feels off....

The furniture looks untouched, the hallway is quiet, and the lights are on. Yet, a deep sense of paranoia sinks in. Was that lantern always angled that way? Was that block always missing? You realize your own familiar home has turned against you.

Your only objective is to walk from the front entrance, navigate through the house, and reach your bedroom on the second floor to finally go to bed, but if there is an anomaly run back outside immediately because it just might not be yours anymore.

Can you survive for 21 days? or will the anomaly get the best of your mind?

A break it all rhythm game.

## Break It All Rhythm Game

## Objective

Break the objects in the room as quickly and as on-beat as possible.

## How to Play

Hit the objects in the room. Break all objects to beat the stage — some larger objects require smaller ones to be broken first. Scoring is based on how in-beat the player is, how many breaks are done consecutively on-beat, and how fast all the objects are destroyed.

name: Roguelite Oneblock
readme:
Roguelite Oneblock, a map where you create your own deck to advance your oneblock!

Roguelite Oneblock is a concept of @goshiggy64. This awesome creator made this as an addon for bedrock edition.

I got inspired by him and made my own version, for java edition.

Make sure to check his version out aswell! You should subscribe to him!

Also I added a [spreadsheet ](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1nkjG5NDh2m7NyGq33oMbIDBXjZmGGmA1/edit?usp=drive_link&ouid=117092991088250082151&rtpof=true&sd=true)which pack contains what.

Note: Some of the textures are created by @goshiggy64 and reused by me.
